newsitem.title: USA: U.S. HEADLINE STOCKS - Issues to watch. [CORRECTED 23:55 GMT]
newsitem.headline: U.S. HEADLINE STOCKS - Issues to watch. [CORRECTED 23:55 GMT]

text.p: * Pfizer Inc is expected to report fourth quarter earnings per share of $0.77, up from $0.64 a year ago, according to First Call. The stock closed at 86-5/8 Wednesday.
* Bank of Boston Corp is expected to report fourth quarter earnings per share of $1.24, compared to $1.17 a year ago, according to First Call. The stock closed at 70-5/8.
* First Union Corp is expected to report fourth quarter earnings per share of $1.66, compared to $1.45 a year ago, according to First Call. The stock closed at 79-5/8.
* Archer Daniels Midland Co is expected to report second quarter earnings per share of $0.40, flat with a year ago, according to First Call. The stock closed at 22-1/2.
* PPG Industries Inc is expected to report fourth quarter earnings per share of $0.87, compared to $0.85 a year ago, according to First Call. The stock closed at 53-1/4.

* Burlington Resources Inc (corrects from Burlington Industries Inc) is expected to report fourth quarter earnings per share of $0.73, compared to $0.18 a year ago, according to First Call. The stock closed at 11-5/8.
* Pacific Telesis Group is expected to report fourth quarter earnings per share of $0.58, compared to $0.54 a year ago, according to First Call. The stock closed at 37-1/4.
* Sun Microsystems Inc, which reported higher fiscal second quarter earnings after Wall Street's close on Wednesday, was up one at 29-1/4 in London.
